summary: Industrial car park beside a rail corridor; no homes nearby, flat.

best_section.where: Northern row of bays at the west end of the car park off Meiers Road

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a planted strip, road and rail line; only commercial buildings nearby, no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with marked bays, entered from Meiers Road; room to stop clear of the road.
drivers.traffic: Busy road and railway just north; noise but the van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Business car park with cars parked in the bays; a van blends in, though it may be for tenants.

flags: Nearby No Stopping Any Time sign on Varley Street, 3.8 m from kerb line
Mapped locked gate 200 m away, not on only access
sun_shade: Open to sun; hedge and trees on the north edge give some shade, trees to the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is tenant-only
